r_template:
local({
  r_vec <- .active_data[[ '{{row_var}}' ]]
  c_vec <- .active_data[[ '{{col_var}}' ]]
  tbl <- table(r_vec, c_vec)
  df_tbl <- as.data.frame.matrix(tbl)
  df_tbl$Total <- rowSums(df_tbl)
  df_tbl <- rbind(df_tbl, Total = colSums(df_tbl))
  df_tbl <- cbind(Row = rownames(df_tbl), df_tbl)
  rrad_emit_table(df_tbl, title = paste('Crosstabulation:', '{{row_var}}', '×', '{{col_var}}'))
  if ({{chk_chisq}}) {
    res_chi <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tbl))
    rrad_emit_table(broom::tidy(res_chi), title = 'Chi-Square Tests')
  }
})
